source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Follow the most stringent regulatory processes and protocol that each department is governed by, which vary, so don’t make false assumptions. It is confusing.
3. Fill out the report to MDAR and the DPH within two hours. If there is not a protocol for these two hours, create one. It could be that if there is an inspection record that two hours later, there is no response to the report, then public notification will be undertaken.
4. Decide that the municipal water department will issue a boil water order within the next two hours. (If these departments are not yet a part of an MOU, they should be.)
5. Distribute boil water orders to local stores.
6. Put information on your website.
7. Notify the media. Clearly explain why the boil water order was necessary.
8. Post on your social media accounts.
9. Let the MDAR Inspector know. Let the health directors
